searchText: Yup, could be leftover from an earlier spec .. that code is from 9 months back or so. Will update in my open PR. (nice catch BTW!) Ah makes sense now The point is that if we let attest quickly after a node does a checkpoint sync, then there is a quick escape for online nodes that have gaps in their blobs. Btw a node that currently comes online with a checkpoint sync needs to wait EL sync. I agree that spec should be more explicit on validator side https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/issues/3099 opened an issue <@504202741933932544> <@291925846556540928>
